name: secrets
description: Agent-friendly secrets vault: CLI + MCP + HTTP serve + SDK. Client: local SQLite vault at ~/.hasna/secrets/vault.db, or the hosted HTTP API (HASNA_SECRETS_API_URL + HASNA_SECRETS_API_KEY). Server: PostgreSQL when HASNA_SECRETS_DATABASE_URL is set, else SQLite. The deployed secrets-serve enforces strict API-key auth (@hasna/contracts).
